#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-

from ctypes import CDLL, c_char_p, c_long, c_int
from subprocess import *
import platform
import os

def pipe_through_prog(prog, text):
    p1 = Popen(prog.split(), stdout=PIPE, stdin=PIPE, stderr=PIPE)
    [result, err] = p1.communicate(input=text.encode('utf-8'))
    return [p1.returncode, result, err]

def use_library(lib, text):
    textbytes = text.encode('utf-8')
    textlen = len(textbytes)
    return [0, lib(textbytes, textlen, 0), '']

class CMark:
    def __init__(self, prog=None, library_dir=None):
        self.prog = prog
        if prog:
            self.to_html = lambda x: pipe_through_prog(prog, x)
        else:
            sysname = platform.system()
            if sysname == 'Darwin':
                libname = "libcmark.dylib"
            elif sysname == 'Windows':
                libname = "cmark.dll"
            else:
                libname = "libcmark.so"
            if library_dir:
                libpath = os.path.join(library_dir, libname)
            else:
                libpath = os.path.join("build", "src", libname)
            cmark = CDLL(libpath)
            markdown = cmark.cmark_markdown_to_html
            markdown.restype = c_char_p
            markdown.argtypes = [c_char_p, c_long, c_int]
            self.to_html = lambda x: use_library(markdown, x)
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-

import sys
from difflib import unified_diff
import argparse
import re
import json
from cmark import CMark
from normalize import normalize_html

if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='Run cmark tests.')
    parser.add_argument('-p', '--program', dest='program', nargs='?', default=None,
            help='program to test')
    parser.add_argument('-s', '--spec', dest='spec', nargs='?', default='spec.txt',
            help='path to spec')
    parser.add_argument('-P', '--pattern', dest='pattern', nargs='?',
            default=None, help='limit to sections matching regex pattern')
    parser.add_argument('--library-dir', dest='library_dir', nargs='?',
            default=None, help='directory containing dynamic library')
    parser.add_argument('--no-normalize', dest='normalize',
            action='store_const', const=False, default=True,
            help='do not normalize HTML')
    parser.add_argument('-d', '--dump-tests', dest='dump_tests',
            action='store_const', const=True, default=False,
            help='dump tests in JSON format')
    parser.add_argument('--debug-normalization', dest='debug_normalization',
            action='store_const', const=True,
            default=False, help='filter stdin through normalizer for testing')
    parser.add_argument('-n', '--number', type=int, default=None,
            help='only consider the test with the given number')
    parser.add_argument('--track', metavar='path',
            help='track which test cases pass/fail in the given JSON file and only report changes')
    args = parser.parse_args(sys.argv[1:])

def out(str):
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(str.encode('utf-8')) 

def print_test_header(test):
    out("Example %d (lines %d-%d) %s\n" % (test['example'], test['start_line'], test['end_line'], test['section']))

def do_test(test, normalize, prev_result):
    [retcode, actual_html_bytes, err] = cmark.to_html(test['markdown'])
    if retcode != 0:
        if prev_result != 'error':
            print_test_header(test)
            out("program returned error code %d\n" % retcode)
            sys.stdout.buffer.write(err)
        return 'error'

    expected_html = test['html']

    try:
        actual_html = actual_html_bytes.decode('utf-8')
    except UnicodeDecodeError as e:
        if prev_result != 'fail':
            print_test_header(test)
            out(test['markdown'] + '\n')
            out("Unicode error: " + str(e) + '\n')
            out("Expected: " + repr(expected_html) + '\n')
            out("Got:      " + repr(actual_html_bytes) + '\n')
            out('\n')
        return 'fail'

    if normalize:
        actual_html = normalize_html(actual_html) + '\n'
        expected_html = normalize_html(expected_html) + '\n'

    if actual_html != expected_html:
        if prev_result != 'fail':
            print_test_header(test)
            out(test['markdown'] + '\n')
            expected_html_lines = expected_html.splitlines(True)
            actual_html_lines = actual_html.splitlines(True)
            for diffline in unified_diff(expected_html_lines, actual_html_lines,
                            "expected HTML", "actual HTML"):
                out(diffline)
            out('\n')
        return 'fail'

    if prev_result and prev_result != 'pass':
        print_test_header(test)
        print('fixed!')

    return 'pass'

def get_tests(specfile):
    line_number = 0
    start_line = 0
    end_line = 0
    example_number = 0
    markdown_lines = []
    html_lines = []
    state = 0  # 0 regular text, 1 markdown example, 2 html output
    headertext = ''
    tests = []

    header_re = re.compile('#+ ')

    with open(specfile, 'r', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n') as specf:
        for line in specf:
            line_number = line_number + 1
            l = line.strip()
            if l == "`" * 32 + " example":
                state = 1
            elif state == 2 and l == "`" * 32:
                state = 0
                example_number = example_number + 1
                end_line = line_number
                tests.append({
                    "markdown":''.join(markdown_lines).replace('→',"\t"),
                    "html":''.join(html_lines).replace('→',"\t"),
                    "example": example_number,
                    "start_line": start_line,
                    "end_line": end_line,
                    "section": headertext})
                start_line = 0
                markdown_lines = []
                html_lines = []
            elif l == ".":
                state = 2
            elif state == 1:
                if start_line == 0:
                    start_line = line_number - 1
                markdown_lines.append(line)
            elif state == 2:
                html_lines.append(line)
            elif state == 0 and re.match(header_re, line):
                headertext = header_re.sub('', line).strip()
    return tests

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if args.debug_normalization:
        out(normalize_html(sys.stdin.read()))
        exit(0)

    all_tests = get_tests(args.spec)
    if args.pattern:
        pattern_re = re.compile(args.pattern, re.IGNORECASE)
    else:
        pattern_re = re.compile('.')
    tests = [ test for test in all_tests if re.search(pattern_re, test['section']) and (not args.number or test['example'] == args.number) ]
    if args.dump_tests:
        out(json.dumps(tests, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
        exit(0)
    else:
        skipped = len(all_tests) - len(tests)
        cmark = CMark(prog=args.program, library_dir=args.library_dir)
        result_counts = {'pass': 0, 'fail': 0, 'error': 0, 'skip': skipped}

        previous = {}

        if args.track:
            try:
                with open(args.track) as f:
                    previous = json.load(f)
            except FileNotFoundError:
                pass

        results = {}

        for test in tests:
            result = do_test(test, args.normalize, previous.get(str(test['example'])))
            result_counts[result] += 1
            results[test['example']] = result

        if args.track:
            with open(args.track, 'w') as f:
                json.dump(results, f)

        out("{pass} passed, {fail} failed, {error} errored, {skip} skipped\n".format(**result_counts))
        exit(result_counts['fail'] + result_counts['error'])

"""Inline and reference link parsing."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
import html
import re

from .inlines import Inline, parse_inlines


@dataclass
class LinkNode:
    type: str
    literal: str = ""
    destination: str = ""
    title: str | None = None
    children: list[Inline | "LinkNode"] | None = None


_ESCAPE = re.compile(r"\\([!\"#$%&'()*+,\-./:;<=>?@\[\\\]^_`{|}~])")
_ENTITY = re.compile(r"&(?:#[xX][0-9A-Fa-f]{1,6}|#[0-9]{1,7}|[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]+);")


def _decode(value: str) -> str:
    value = _ESCAPE.sub(r"\1", value)
    return _ENTITY.sub(lambda m: html.unescape(m.group()), value)


def _normalize_label(label: str) -> str:
    return " ".join(label.casefold().split())


def _destination_and_title(source: str, start: int) -> tuple[str, str | None, int] | None:
    """Parse the contents after an opening parenthesis; return end after ')' ."""
    i, n = start, len(source)
    while i < n and source[i] in " \t\n\r":
        i += 1
    destination = ""
    if i < n and source[i] == "<":
        i += 1
        part: list[str] = []
        while i < n:
            if source[i] == "\\" and i + 1 < n:
                part.extend((source[i], source[i + 1])); i += 2; continue
            if source[i] == "<" or source[i] in "\r\n":
                return None
            if source[i] == ">":
                i += 1; destination = _decode("".join(part)); break
            part.append(source[i]); i += 1
        else:
            return None
    else:
        depth, part = 0, []
        while i < n:
            c = source[i]
            if c == "\\" and i + 1 < n:
                part.extend((c, source[i + 1])); i += 2; continue
            if c in " \t\n\r":
                break
            if c == "(":
                depth += 1
                if depth > 32: return None
            elif c == ")":
                if depth == 0: break
                depth -= 1
            part.append(c); i += 1
        if depth:
            return None
        destination = _decode("".join(part))
    whitespace = i
    while i < n and source[i] in " \t\n\r":
        i += 1
    separated = i > whitespace
    title = None
    if i < n and source[i] in "\"'(":
        opener = source[i]; closer = ")" if opener == "(" else opener
        i += 1; part = []
        while i < n:
            c = source[i]
            if c == "\\" and i + 1 < n:
                part.extend((c, source[i + 1])); i += 2; continue
            if c == closer:
                title = _decode("".join(part)); i += 1; break
            if c in "\r\n" and opener != "(":
                return None
            part.append(c); i += 1
        else:
            return None
        if not separated:  # title must be separated from destination
            return None
        while i < n and source[i] in " \t\n\r": i += 1
    if i >= n or source[i] != ")":
        return None
    return destination, title, i + 1


def _bracket_end(source: str, opening: int) -> int | None:
    depth, i = 1, opening + 1
    while i < len(source):
        if source[i] == "\\":
            i += 2; continue
        if source[i] == "[": depth += 1
        elif source[i] == "]":
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0: return i
        i += 1
    return None


def parse_links(source: str, references: dict) -> list[Inline | LinkNode]:
    """Parse links from inline source using an already collected reference map."""
    result: list[Inline | LinkNode] = []
    text: list[str] = []

    def flush() -> None:
        if text:
            result.append(Inline("text", "".join(text)))
            text.clear()

    i = 0
    while i < len(source):
        if source[i] == "\\" and i + 1 < len(source):
            text.extend(source[i:i + 2]); i += 2; continue
        if source[i] != "[" or (i and source[i - 1] == "!"):
            text.append(source[i]); i += 1; continue
        close = _bracket_end(source, i)
        if close is None:
            text.append(source[i]); i += 1; continue
        label_source = source[i + 1:close]
        parsed: tuple[str, str | None, int] | None = None
        after = close + 1
        if after < len(source) and source[after] == "(":
            parsed = _destination_and_title(source, after + 1)
        if parsed is not None:
            dest, title, end = parsed
        else:
            reference_label = label_source
            end = after
            if after < len(source) and source[after] == "[":
                ref_close = _bracket_end(source, after)
                if ref_close is not None:
                    reference_label = source[after + 1:ref_close] or label_source
                    end = ref_close + 1
            entry = references.get(_normalize_label(_decode(reference_label)))
            if entry is None:
                text.append(source[i]); i += 1; continue
            if isinstance(entry, dict):
                dest, title = entry.get("destination", ""), entry.get("title")
            else:
                dest, title = entry[0], entry[1] if len(entry) > 1 else None
        flush()
        result.append(LinkNode("link", destination=dest, title=title,
                               children=parse_inlines(label_source, {})))
        i = end
    flush()
    return result
"""Inline text parsing for code spans, escapes, references, and soft breaks."""

from dataclasses import dataclass
import html.entities
import re


@dataclass
class Inline:
    """An inline text node or a soft line break."""

    type: str
    literal: str = ""
    destination: str = ""
    label: str = ""
    children: list["Inline"] | None = None


_ENTITY = re.compile(r"&(?:#[xX][0-9A-Fa-f]{1,6}|#[0-9]{1,7}|[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]+);")
_ASCII_PUNCTUATION = frozenset("!\"#$%&'()*+,-./:;<=>?@[\\]^_`{|}~")
_C1 = {
    0x80: 0x20AC, 0x82: 0x201A, 0x83: 0x0192, 0x84: 0x201E,
    0x85: 0x2026, 0x86: 0x2020, 0x87: 0x2021, 0x88: 0x02C6,
    0x89: 0x2030, 0x8A: 0x0160, 0x8B: 0x2039, 0x8C: 0x0152,
    0x8E: 0x017D, 0x91: 0x2018, 0x92: 0x2019, 0x93: 0x201C,
    0x94: 0x201D, 0x95: 0x2022, 0x96: 0x2013, 0x97: 0x2014,
    0x98: 0x02DC, 0x99: 0x2122, 0x9A: 0x0161, 0x9B: 0x203A,
    0x9C: 0x0153, 0x9E: 0x017E, 0x9F: 0x0178,
}


def _reference(match: re.Match[str]) -> str:
    token = match.group()
    if token.startswith("&#"):
        body = token[2:-1]
        try:
            value = int(body[1:], 16) if body[:1] in "xX" else int(body, 10)
        except ValueError:
            return token
        if value == 0 or value > 0x10FFFF or 0xD800 <= value <= 0xDFFF:
            value = 0xFFFD
        else:
            value = _C1.get(value, value)
        return chr(value)
    return html.entities.html5.get(token[1:], token)


def parse_inlines(source: str, references: dict) -> list[Inline]:
    """Parse code spans, ordinary text, punctuation escapes, references, and breaks."""
    del references  # Reserved for reference-link parsing in the inline pipeline.
    nodes: list[Inline] = []
    text: list[str] = []

    def flush() -> None:
        if text:
            value = "".join(text)
            if value:
                nodes.append(Inline("text", value))
            text.clear()

    i = 0
    while i < len(source):
        char = source[i]
        if char == "`":
            run_end = i + 1
            while run_end < len(source) and source[run_end] == "`":
                run_end += 1
            run_length = run_end - i
            search = run_end
            close_start = close_end = -1
            while search < len(source):
                candidate = source.find("`", search)
                if candidate < 0:
                    break
                candidate_end = candidate + 1
                while candidate_end < len(source) and source[candidate_end] == "`":
                    candidate_end += 1
                if candidate_end - candidate == run_length:
                    close_start, close_end = candidate, candidate_end
                    break
                search = candidate_end
            if close_start >= 0:
                flush()
                literal = source[run_end:close_start].replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n").replace("\n", " ")
                if len(literal) >= 2 and literal.startswith(" ") and literal.endswith(" ") and literal.strip(" "):
                    literal = literal[1:-1]
                nodes.append(Inline("code", literal))
                i = close_end
            else:
                text.append(source[i:run_end])
                i = run_end
        elif char == "\\" and i + 1 < len(source) and source[i + 1] in _ASCII_PUNCTUATION:
            text.append(source[i + 1])
            i += 2
        elif char == "&":
            match = _ENTITY.match(source, i)
            if match:
                text.append(_reference(match))
                i = match.end()
            else:
                text.append(char)
                i += 1
        elif char == "\n":
            while text and text[-1] == " ":
                text.pop()
            flush()
            while i + 1 < len(source) and source[i + 1] == " ":
                i += 1
            nodes.append(Inline("softbreak"))
            i += 1
        else:
            text.append(char)
            i += 1
    flush()
    return _parse_emphasis(nodes)


def _parse_emphasis(nodes: list[Inline]) -> list[Inline]:
    """Resolve delimiter runs in text nodes, leaving code spans opaque."""
    result: list[Inline] = []
    for node in nodes:
        if node.type != "text":
            result.append(node)
            continue
        source = node.literal
        # Match valid flanking pairs from the inside out. The pass only handles
        # delimiter characters; punctuation and Unicode whitespace use the
        # same flanking predicates as the CommonMark delimiter rules.
        chunks: list[Inline] = []
        i = 0
        plain = 0
        while i < len(source):
            if source[i] not in "*_":
                i += 1
                continue
            end = i + 1
            while end < len(source) and source[end] == source[i]:
                end += 1
            marker, length = source[i], end - i
            before = source[i - 1] if i else "\n"
            after = source[end] if end < len(source) else "\n"
            opener = not after.isspace() and (not _punct(after) or before.isspace() or _punct(before))
            closer = not before.isspace() and (not _punct(before) or after.isspace() or _punct(after))
            if marker == "_":
                opener = opener and (not closer or _punct(before))
                closer = closer and (not opener or _punct(after))
            if not opener:
                i = end
                continue
            close = end
            found = None
            while close < len(source):
                candidate = source.find(marker, close)
                if candidate < 0:
                    break
                ce = candidate + 1
                while ce < len(source) and source[ce] == marker:
                    ce += 1
                cb = source[candidate - 1] if candidate else "\n"
                ca = source[ce] if ce < len(source) else "\n"
                can_close = not cb.isspace() and (not _punct(cb) or ca.isspace() or _punct(ca))
                if marker == "_":
                    can_close = can_close and (not (not cright and (not cleft or _punct(ca))) or _punct(ca))
                use = 2 if length >= 2 and ce - candidate >= 2 else 1
                if can_close and candidate > end and not (marker == "_" and before.isalnum() and ca.isalnum()):
                    found = (candidate, ce, use)
                    break
                close = ce
            if found is None:
                i = end
                continue
            a, b, use = found
            prefix = source[plain:i] + marker * (length - use)
            if prefix:
                chunks.append(Inline("text", prefix))
            inner = _parse_emphasis([Inline("text", source[end:a])])
            chunks.append(Inline("strong" if use == 2 else "em", children=inner))
            source = source[:i] + source[end:a] + source[b:]
            i = i + (a - end)
            plain = i
        tail = source[plain:]
        if tail:
            chunks.append(Inline("text", tail))
        result.extend(chunks or [node])
    return result


def _punct(char: str) -> bool:
    return bool(char) and (char in _ASCII_PUNCTUATION or __import__("unicodedata").category(char).startswith("P"))
"""CommonMark parser integration interfaces."""

from .blocks import Document, parse_blocks
from .inlines import parse_inlines


def render(markdown: str) -> str:
    """Render a complete Markdown document to HTML.

    This foundation exposes the integration point; parsing and rendering behavior
    are supplied by later parser capabilities.
    """
    document = parse_blocks(markdown)
    for block in document.children:
        if block.kind in {"paragraph", "heading"}:
            parse_inlines(block.literal, document.references)
    return ""


__all__ = ["Document", "parse_blocks", "parse_inlines", "render"]
from commonmark_parser.links import parse_links


def test_inline_link_destination_title_and_children():
    nodes = parse_links('[label](/destination "caption")', {})
    assert len(nodes) == 1
    link = nodes[0]
    assert (link.type, link.destination, link.title) == ("link", "/destination", "caption")
    assert [(child.type, child.literal) for child in link.children] == [("text", "label")]


def test_full_collapsed_and_shortcut_references_normalize_labels():
    refs = {"reference": {"destination": "/target", "title": None}}
    for source in ("[visible][REFERENCE]", "[reference][]", "[reference]"):
        nodes = parse_links(source, refs)
        assert len(nodes) == 1
        assert (nodes[0].type, nodes[0].destination, nodes[0].title) == ("link", "/target", None)


def test_inline_destination_supports_balanced_parentheses_and_escapes():
    nodes = parse_links(r"[x](a_(b\)))", {})
    assert nodes[0].destination == "a_(b))"


def test_angle_destination_decodes_entities_and_title_quote_styles():
    nodes = parse_links("[x](</a&b> 'a \\\'quote\\'')", {})
    assert nodes[0].destination == "/a&b"
    assert nodes[0].title == "a 'quote'"


def test_unresolved_reference_and_image_remain_text():
    nodes = parse_links("[missing] ![image](src)", {})
    assert [(node.type, node.literal) for node in nodes] == [("text", "[missing] ![image](src)")]


def test_links_are_parsed_in_order_and_unlinked_text_is_preserved():
    nodes = parse_links("before [a](/a) middle [b](/b) after", {})
    assert [(n.type, n.literal if n.type == "text" else n.destination) for n in nodes] == [
        ("text", "before "), ("link", "/a"), ("text", " middle "),
        ("link", "/b"), ("text", " after")]

    source = "alpha_beta_gamma"
    nodes = parse_inlines(source, {})
    assert all(n.type == "text" for n in nodes)
    assert "".join(n.literal for n in nodes) == source


def test_autolinks_uri_email_and_invalid_uri():
    uri = "https://example.test/path"
    nodes = parse_autolinks(f"<{uri}>")
    assert [(n.type, n.destination, n.label) for n in nodes] == [("link", uri, uri)]
    nodes = parse_autolinks("<person@example.test>")
    assert [(n.type, n.destination, n.label) for n in nodes] == [("link", "mailto:person@example.test", "person@example.test")]
    source = "<https://example.test/a b>"
    nodes = parse_autolinks(source)
    assert all(n.type == "text" for n in nodes)
    assert "".join(n.literal for n in nodes) == source


def test_inline_html_preserves_tag():
    tag = '<custom data-value="sample">'
    nodes = parse_inline_html_breaks(tag)
    assert [(n.type, n.literal) for n in nodes] == [("html", tag)]


def test_hard_breaks_for_spaces_and_backslash():
    for source in ("first  \nsecond", "first\\\nsecond"):
        nodes = parse_inline_html_breaks(source)
        assert sum(n.type == "hardbreak" for n in nodes) == 1
    source = "ending\\"
    nodes = parse_inline_html_breaks(source)
    assert all(n.type != "hardbreak" for n in nodes)
    assert "".join(n.literal for n in nodes if n.type == "text") == source


def test_invalid_html_remains_text():
    source = "<1not>"
    nodes = parse_inline_html_breaks(source)
    assert [(n.type, n.literal) for n in nodes] == [("text", source)]
